title: Infinite Moments of Class Groups for Solvable Fields with a Normal Abelian Subgroup
summary: We apply the class field theory and Minkowski bound to obtain an upper bound estimate for the number of solutions to the restricted ramifications when the Galois group is solvable. Together with suitable conditions on the solvable group and the ordering of number fields, we could prove an upper bound on specific field-counting problems, hence the infinite moment of the class groups.
